usage: agentware plan [-h] <subcommand> ...

positional arguments:
  <subcommand>
    lint             lint a feature plan against the R1–R16 structural
                     contract
    verify-premises  re-verify a plan's declared `## Premises` against LIVE
                     state (read-only; a reproduced falsification exits 1 —
                     the loop pre-hook halts a load-bearing run before phase
                     1)
    new              scaffold a lint-passing plan.md (seeds the mandatory
                     [e2e]+[kb] pair)
    add-task         insert a task before the trailing [e2e]+[kb] pair and
                     renumber
    set-status       flip a task marker (todo|wip|done) in place, line-local
    set-state        transition a plan's lifecycle state
                     (draft|ready|running|done|superseded|cancelled) via the
                     legal-transition matrix
    state-backfill   stamp a derived `> Status:` on every legacy plan lacking
                     one (migration 001; never overwrites, skips the live
                     feature)
    claim            loop START-edge: bring a plan to running
                     (draft->ready->running / ready->running / running re-
                     claim), or refuse a terminal plan
    target-dirs      print declared target-package dirs from a plan (one per
                     line)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
